title: The Family / The Fellowship network in government
summary: Jason Simosa tells of The Family / The Fellowship network in government, about 1930s onward at Washington, D.C., and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: you look into this organization called The Family, The Fellowship, they were founded in the '30s and really took off in the post-war era.

plain: A researcher, Jason Simosa, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, describes a quiet network in Washington, DC known as The Family, or The Fellowship. He says it was founded in the 1930s and really took off after the Second World War, and he draws on the writer Jeff Sharlet and a man named Alonzo McDonald. He brings it up because, if he is right, a group like this would sit close to the people who decide what the government keeps secret about UFOs.
